{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|You can't bargain away a debt to your ghrakhowsk with a mere ''ship!'' While he breathes, my service is his! Where Gryph goes, I go!|Slyssk|<ref name="KOTOR13:DoF1">[[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]</ref>}}
In the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] tradition of the [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]], the being to whom a Trandoshan swore their very first life debt to was known as their '''ghrakhowsk'''. A Trandoshan is expected to serve and follow their ghrakhowsk for as long as they live.

[[Marn Hierogryph]] became [[Slyssk]]'s ghrakhowsk after pretending to save Slssyk's life by pushing him out of the way of a falling piece of machinery.
